newsitem.title: CANADA: GE unit to acquire up to 19.9 pct ALI.
newsitem.headline: GE unit to acquire up to 19.9 pct ALI.

text.p: ALI Technologies Inc said on Monday that GE Medical Systems (GEMS), a division of General Electric Co, would invest up to C$13.6 million in ALI after the two parties signed a letter of intent to create a strategic technology and marketing agreement.

ALI said it would issue preferred shares with aggregate value of C$8.16 million, which would have rights of conversion at a price of C$6.80 a share. ALI said it might also issue additional preferred shares valued at up to C$5.44 million, which would have rights of conversion at a price of not less than C$6.80 a share.
The preferred shares would be convertible into not more than two million common shares and would represent not more than 19.9 percent of the total common shares outstanding after financing, ALI said.

"The agreement between ALI and GEMS is intended to create value for both parties by co-operating in the development and marketing of medical image management technology, products and systems," ALI Chief Executive Greg Peet said.
